title: Workplace
purpose: Workplace is the office's day-to-day hub. Here you schedule meetings with agendas, record decisions and action items, and issue numbered minutes. Everyone keeps their tasks on a board, management publishes announcements and formal circulars (with acknowledgement tracking), and the office keeps an asset register and a visitor log.

who.does: Hold every permission: schedule meetings, issue minutes, assign tasks to anyone, publish announcements, issue circulars, keep the asset register and visitor log.
Have the workplace manage permission by default, so they can do the same as the partners in this module.
View meetings and circulars, acknowledge circulars, read announcements, and create and work on their own tasks. They cannot schedule meetings, assign tasks to others, or open Assets and Visitors.

before_you_start: Every colleague who should attend meetings, get tasks or receive circulars needs a user account with the right role (Access module).
Circulars and minutes are printed on the company letterhead from the Company module, so the company profile should be complete.
Announcements and circulars can be sent to everyone or only to selected roles.

tasks.title: Start your day on Workplace Home
steps: Open the Workplace module from the launcher; Workplace Home opens first.
Read the tiles: Meetings this week, My open tasks, Overdue, To acknowledge. Click a tile to open the list behind it.
Check Upcoming meetings, My tasks due, Overdue tasks and Announcements.
If 'Circulars waiting for your acknowledgement' appears, click Read and acknowledge.
tasks.result: Nothing changes; you see what needs your attention. New task and Schedule meeting buttons are at the top.

tasks.title: Schedule a meeting with attendees and an agenda
tasks.who: Admin, Partners, HR Manager, Project Manager
tasks.where: Workplace > Meetings > Schedule meeting (or '+ New' > Meeting)
steps: Click Meetings, then Schedule meeting. (In Month view you can also click a date number.)
Enter the Title, for example 'Monthly partners review', and choose the Type (Partners, Board, Team, Client or Vendor).
Enter the Date, Start time and End time, the Venue and/or the Online meeting link (must start with https://).
Choose the Organiser (leave as Me for yourself).
If it repeats, choose Repeats (Every week or Every month) and Further meetings to create, for example 3.
Under Attendees from the team, tick the colleagues. Click Add outside attendee for guests and enter their name and designation or company.
Under Agenda, click Add agenda item and enter each Item, its Owner and Minutes, for example 'Cash flow review', 'Ravi', 20.
Click Schedule meeting.
tasks.result: The meeting gets a meeting ID (shown in the message) and opens on its own page with status Scheduled. For a repeating meeting the further meetings are created at once, one per week or month.
tips: End time must be after start time.

tasks.title: Edit a meeting or create the next meetings in a series
tasks.who: Admin, Partners, HR Manager, Project Manager
tasks.where: Workplace > Meetings > open the meeting > Edit / Create next meetings
steps: Open the meeting from the calendar or the All meetings tab.
Click Edit to change details, attendees or agenda, then click Save meeting.
For a repeating meeting, click Create next meetings, enter How many more (1 to 52) and click Create meetings.
tasks.result: New meetings follow the latest one in the series with the same attendees and agenda; dates that already exist are skipped.

tasks.title: Reschedule, cancel, reopen, mark as held or delete a meeting
tasks.who: Admin, Partners, HR Manager, Project Manager
steps: To move it: click Reschedule, enter the New date, times and a Reason, and click Reschedule.
To call it off: click Cancel meeting, enter the reason (required) and confirm.
To bring back a cancelled meeting: click Reopen.
After it takes place: click Mark as held.
To remove it completely: click Delete and confirm. Delete is shown only while no minutes have been issued.
tasks.result: The status changes to Rescheduled, Cancelled, Scheduled or Held, and the reason is shown on the meeting. Deleting removes the meeting, agenda and attendee list; action items already created stay in Tasks.

tasks.title: Record decisions taken in a meeting
tasks.who: Admin, Partners, HR Manager, Project Manager
tasks.where: Workplace > Meetings > open the meeting > Decisions
steps: In the Decisions card, type the decision in Add a decision, for example 'Approve purchase of two laptops up to ₹1,20,000'.
Click Add.
To remove a decision, click the × next to it.
tasks.result: The decision is listed on the meeting and is pre-filled into the minutes.

tasks.title: Add action items from a meeting
tasks.who: Admin, Partners, HR Manager, Project Manager
tasks.where: Workplace > Meetings > open the meeting > Action items > Add action item
steps: In the Action items card, click Add action item.
Enter the Title, Description, Assigned to, Due date and Priority, and optionally Labels and Project.
Click Create task.
tasks.result: The action item becomes a numbered task in Tasks (its Source shows the meeting) and in the assignee's My tasks. It is also pre-filled into the minutes.
tips: Click an action item to open the task and update it.

tasks.title: Record and issue the minutes of meeting
tasks.who: Admin, Partners, HR Manager, Project Manager
tasks.where: Workplace > Meetings > open the meeting > Record minutes
steps: Open the meeting and click Record minutes. The form is pre-filled from the meeting, agenda, decisions and action items.
Check Meeting title, times, Venue, Mode (In person, Online, Hybrid), Minutes taken by and Next meeting.
Under Attendees, set each person's Attendance (Present, Absent, Apologies).
Edit the Agenda (one item per line), Discussion and decisions, and Action items.
Click Issue minutes and confirm with Issue minutes.
tasks.result: The minutes are numbered under the meeting ID and saved exactly as written; they are listed under Minutes of meeting with Letterhead PDF (and Print PDF) download buttons.
tips: Issued minutes cannot be edited. If they are wrong, void them in Company > Minutes of meeting and issue them again.
Add at least attendees, an agenda or one discussion item.

tasks.title: Attach meeting papers
tasks.who: Admin, Partners, HR Manager, Project Manager (others can download)
tasks.where: Workplace > Meetings > open the meeting > Meeting papers
steps: Scroll to Meeting papers.
Choose the File (PDF, PNG or JPEG), enter a Name and, if needed, an Expires date.
Click Attach file.
tasks.result: The paper is listed with Download and Remove buttons.

tasks.title: Create a task
tasks.who: Everyone (only managers can assign to other people)
tasks.where: Workplace > Tasks or My Tasks > New task (or '+ New' > Task)
steps: Click New task.
Enter the Title, for example 'Renew office internet plan', and a Description.
Managers choose Assigned to; everyone else creates tasks for themselves (shown as Me).
Enter the Due date, Priority (Low, Medium, High, Urgent), Labels separated by commas, and the Project if it belongs to one.
Click Create task.
tasks.result: The task gets a number (shown in the message) and status To do.

tasks.title: Work on a task: move it, tick the checklist, comment
tasks.who: The assignee, the person who raised it, or a manager
tasks.where: Workplace > Tasks (Board or List) > click the task
steps: On the Board, drag a card to another column, or use its Move to… box.
Click a task title to open it. In Move to, choose In progress, Blocked, Done or Cancelled.
Under Checklist, type in Add a checklist item and click Add; tick items as you finish them.
Under Comments, type in Add a comment and click Post comment.
The person who raised the task (or a manager) can click Edit task to change details, then Save task, or Delete to remove it.
tasks.result: The board updates; a Done task records its completion time. A Done or Cancelled task can only be moved back to To do.
tips: Tasks past their due date show an Overdue badge.

tasks.title: See only your tasks (My tasks)
steps: Click My Tasks.
Use the chips Open, All, To do, In progress, Blocked, Done, Cancelled and Overdue only.
Use Search and Priority, and switch between Board and List.
tasks.result: Only tasks assigned to you are shown.

tasks.title: Filter tasks and see task analytics
tasks.who: Managers see all tasks; others see tasks they raised or that are assigned to them
steps: Click Tasks and use the status chips, Overdue only, Search, Priority and (managers) Assigned to.
Click Show analytics to see Tasks by status, Open tasks by person and Completed per week.
tasks.result: The footer shows the number of tasks and how many are overdue.

tasks.title: Publish an announcement
tasks.who: Admin, Partners, HR Manager, Project Manager
tasks.where: Workplace > Announcements > New announcement (or '+ New' > Announcement)
steps: Click Announcements, then New announcement.
Enter the Title and the Message (Markdown works: **bold**, *italic*, lists with -). A Preview appears below.
Choose the audience: everyone, or selected roles.
Set Publish on (today, or a later date) and Expires on (optional).
Tick Pin to the top of the feed if it is important.
Click Publish.
To change or remove one later, open the Manage all tab and click Edit or Delete.
tasks.result: The announcement shows in the Feed (and on Workplace Home) for its audience from the publish date until it expires. In Manage all its state is live, scheduled or expired.

tasks.title: Draft and issue a circular
tasks.who: Admin, Partners, HR Manager, Project Manager
tasks.where: Workplace > Circulars > New circular (or '+ New' > Circular)
steps: Click Circulars, then New circular.
Enter the Subject, Addressed to (for example 'All employees'; leave empty to use the audience), Issue date, the audience, and the Text of the circular.
Click Save draft. The draft opens.
Check it, use Edit if needed, then click Issue circular and confirm.
tasks.result: The circular gets a reference number, is printed on the company letterhead (Letterhead PDF and Print PDF buttons), and its audience is asked to acknowledge it. After issue it cannot be edited or deleted.
tips: A draft can be deleted with Delete. Attach enclosures under Enclosures.

tasks.title: Acknowledge a circular, and track who has
steps: Click the Waiting for my acknowledgement chip (or the To acknowledge tile on Workplace Home).
Open the circular, read it and click I have read and acknowledge this.
Managers: open an issued circular and look at Acknowledgements. Use the tabs Everyone, Waiting and Acknowledged.
tasks.result: Your acknowledgement is recorded with the date and time. Managers see 'n of n acknowledged' and who is still waiting; the list shows the count per circular.

tasks.title: Keep the office asset register
tasks.who: Admin, Partners, HR Manager, Project Manager
steps: Click Assets, then Add asset.
Enter the Name (for example 'Dell laptop'), Category, Serial number and Status (In stock, In use, In repair, Retired, Lost).
Choose Assigned to, and enter Location, Purchase date, Purchase value (INR), for example 65,000, and Warranty expiry.
Click Add asset. The asset stays open so you can attach the invoice and warranty papers.
To update an asset (for example when it is handed to someone else), click Open, change the fields and click Save asset.
Use Search (name, tag, serial number), Status and Category to find assets.
tasks.result: Each asset gets an automatic tag such as T2N-AST-26-2411-0001. The tiles show the number of assets, total purchase value, how many are in use and how many warranties end within 60 days.
tips: If an asset is only out of use, set its status to Retired instead of deleting it.

tasks.title: Sign visitors in and out
tasks.who: Admin, Partners, HR Manager, Project Manager
tasks.where: Workplace > Visitors > Sign in a visitor
steps: Click Visitors, then Sign in a visitor.
Enter the Visitor name, Company, Phone, Time in (filled with now) and Purpose of visit.
In Meeting (host), choose the colleague, or choose Someone else and type the Host name.
Click Sign in.
When the visitor leaves, click Sign out on their row.
Use the chips In the office, A day (choose the Day) and All, and Search, to look back.
tasks.result: The tiles show who is in the office now and how many visitors came today. Sign out records the time out.
tips: Delete removes an entry from the log and is recorded in the change history.

statuses.name: Meeting: Rescheduled
statuses.meaning: Moved to a new date or time, with a reason.

statuses.name: Meeting: Cancelled
statuses.meaning: Called off with a reason; can be reopened.

statuses.name: Task: To do / In progress / Blocked / Done / Cancelled
statuses.meaning: Where a task stands; Done and Cancelled can only go back to To do. An Overdue badge shows when an open task is past its due date.

statuses.name: Circular: Draft / Issued
statuses.meaning: A draft can be edited or deleted; an issued circular is numbered, on letterhead and frozen.

statuses.name: Announcement: live / scheduled / expired
statuses.meaning: Shown now, waiting for its publish date, or past its expiry date.

statuses.name: Asset: In stock / In use / In repair / Retired / Lost
statuses.meaning: Where the asset is; the warranty badge shows In warranty, Expiring soon (within 60 days) or Expired.

statuses.name: Visitor: Inside
statuses.meaning: Signed in and not yet signed out.

daily: Check Workplace Home and My Tasks; move tasks along and tick checklists.
Acknowledge any circulars waiting for you.
Front office: sign visitors in and out.
weekly: Managers: review Overdue tasks and the Open tasks by person chart.
Prepare agendas for the coming week's meetings and record minutes for meetings held.
monthly: Check acknowledgement progress on recent circulars and remind those still waiting.
Update the asset register for any handovers, repairs or new purchases.
yearly: Review the asset register against the physical items and mark lost or retired assets.
Create the next set of meetings for repeating series.

common_problems.problem: I cannot see Schedule meeting, Assets or Visitors.
common_problems.fix: These need the workplace manage permission (Admin, Partners, HR Manager, Project Manager by default).

common_problems.problem: I cannot assign a task to a colleague.
common_problems.fix: Only managers can assign to others; everyone else creates tasks for themselves.
Issued minutes cannot be edited. Void them in Company > Minutes of meeting and record them again from the meeting.

common_problems.problem: The Delete button is missing on a meeting.
common_problems.fix: Minutes have been issued for it. Cancel the meeting instead, or void the minutes first.
Once issued it is frozen. Issue a new circular with the correction.
The link must start with http:// or https://.

connected: Company module: minutes of meeting and circulars are issued and numbered there, on the company letterhead; voiding minutes is done there.
Projects: a task can be linked to a project.
Access: user roles decide who can manage Workplace and who receives role-targeted announcements and circulars.
